title: teslalog: Statistics
description: Monthly driving trends - time driven, distance, avg outside temp, drive count, and efficiency - matching TeslaMate's own Statistics dashboard's per-month view. Skips its energy-used/charging columns (those live in teslalog-charging-stats.json instead, to avoid duplicating the same figures two different ways).

targets.queryText:
SELECT
  strftime('%Y-%m', start_time) AS "Month",
  ROUND(SUM(duration_min), 0) AS "Minutes driven",
  ROUND(SUM(distance_km), 1) AS "Distance (km)",
  ROUND(AVG(outside_temp_avg_c), 1) AS "Ø Temp (C)",
  COUNT(*) AS "# of drives",
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(distance_km) / NULLIF(SUM(MAX(start_range_km - end_range_km, 0)), 0), 0) AS "Efficiency %"
FROM drives
WHERE status = 'closed'
GROUP BY "Month"
ORDER BY "Month" DESC
